findings.description: The section is shown only when every argument has help, so a command with both documented and undocumented arguments loses its entire positional arguments section.
findings.rationale: For a command with two arguments where one has help text and the other has help=None, all(...) evaluates to false and skips rendering every record. Users therefore see neither the documented argument's help nor the exhaustive argument list intended by this change. The condition should check whether at least one argument is documented.
